card.name: Garbled or split-up words in text
card.fires_on: Responds to odd, split or OCR-damaged word pieces where a short word is broken up, such as a lost space or stray invisible character. It also fires on the word 'is' or 'attached' in physics problems.

modes.label: Invisible characters in text
modes.description: A hidden space character sits between words in drug-label text, before a term like titration or fatal.

modes.label: OCR-damaged short words
modes.description: A short word is cut or misread, such as 'the' appearing as 'fr', 'die' or 't'.

modes.label: Physics problem wording
modes.description: Verb pieces in spring and box physics questions, where a word is run together.
